quizzes.question: Which of these belongs in the KPIs / targets dimension, not the breakthrough objectives?
options: Raise first-pass yield to 99% this year
quizzes.explanation: A target is measurable, with a number and a date. The others are directional objectives, not measures.

quizzes.question: Arjun's annual on-time delivery goal has no project linked to it. What should he do FIRST?
options: Mark a strong link to the nearest project
Find or launch a project that can move delivery — or rethink the goal
Leave it; the KPI will improve on its own
quizzes.explanation: A goal with no supporting project is a gap. Close it with real work, or revise the goal; never fill the box with a link that has no mechanism.
